caseNameFull: UNITED STATES v. POLLARD UNITED STATES v. KOHN UNITED STATES v. STANTON
summary:
APPEALS EROM THE COURT OF CLAIMS.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. Attorney General and Mr. B. S. Hale for appellant., Mr. A.- G. Biddle for Pollard, Mr. J. A. Wills for Kohn, and Mr. George. Taylor for Stanton. .

opinions.author: Davis
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Davis

delivered the opinion of the court.

There are no material points of difference between these cases and the case of The United States v. Anderson, 9 Wall. 56, decided at this term, and the views presented in that case dispose of these.

The judgment of the Court of Claims in each of the above-named cases is Affirmed,

Mr. Attorney General and Mr. B. S. Hale for appellant. Mr. A.- G. Biddle for Pollard, Mr. J. A. Wills for Kohn, and Mr. George. Taylor for Stanton. .
